Sure thing! Below is a step‑by‑step guide to building a simple, but professional‑looking website for your dog‑walking business. I’ll keep it beginner‑friendly, but I’ll also drop some optional “extra” features you can add later if you want to grow your online presence. --- ## 1. Plan Out What the Site Needs | Section | Content Ideas | Why It Matters | |---------|---------------|----------------| | **Home** | Hero banner (big photo of dogs), tagline, quick “Book Now” button | First impression, CTA | | **About** | Your story, qualifications, why you love dogs | Builds trust | | **Services** | Walk lengths, prices, group vs. solo walks, special service (grooming, training) | Let people know what you offer | | **Gallery** | Photos of dogs you’ve walked | Shows real work | | **Rates** | Clear pricing table | Transparency | | **Testimonials** | Quotes from happy owners | Social proof | | **Contact** | Phone, email, online booking link, Google Map | Easy to reach you | | **FAQ** | Common questions (insurance, emergency handling, cancellations) | Reduce email clutter | --- ## 2. Choose a Platform (or Build from Scratch) | Option | Pros | Cons | Cost | |--------|------|------|------| | **Wix / Squarespace / WordPress.com** | Drag‑and‑drop, templates, hosting included | Limited custom code | $10–$30/month | | **WordPress.org** + free theme + own hosting | Full control, thousands of plugins | Requires a bit of setup | £5–£15/month (hosting) | | **Static HTML/CSS + Netlify** | Very fast, free deployment, no hosting cost | All code is static, you do the work | Free | **Recommended for Beginners:** *Wix* or *Squarespace* – quick, no coding required. **If you’re comfortable with a bit of code:** *WordPress.org* with a theme like **Astra** or **GeneratePress** and the **Elementor** page builder. --- ## 3. Step‑by‑Step for a Wix Site (Fastest Path) 1. **Sign Up & Choose Template** • Go to [Wix.com](https://www.wix.com). • Pick “Pet Services” under “Business” – they have a few dog‑walking templates. 2. **Edit the Hero Section** • Upload a high‑resolution photo of a dog you have walked. • Add a headline, e.g., “Strolls, Walks, & Joy for Your Best Friend.” • Add a CTA button: “Book a Walk” → link to a booking page or form. 3. **Add Pages** • Home (the hero page) • About – tell your story, show a photo of you, add a short intro paragraph. • Services – create a carousel or list items with icons and prices. • Gallery – use the built‑in image gallery to show dogs in action. • Contact – add a Wix form, map, phone & email. 4. **Make It Mobile‑Friendly** • Wix auto‑generates a mobile view, but review it. Make sure buttons are tappable and text is readable. 5. **Integrate a Booking System** • Wix’s “Wix Bookings” lets customers book a walk, pay (via Stripe), and see availability. • If you prefer a third‑party tool, embed a Calendly or SimplyBook link in the “Book a Walk” button. 6. **SEO Basics** • Under “Site” → “SEO” → “Search Engine Visibility”, set a page title (“Dog Walking in [Your City] – [Your Business Name]”). • Add meta description: “Professional dog walking services in [City]…”. 7. **Publish & Test** • Click “Publish”. • Test on desktop, tablet, phone. • Send the link to friends and ask for feedback. --- ## 4.
